#### 1. immunodeficiency 120  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.779)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:9175)

**Proposed mechanism:** POLD1 (HGNC:9175) —DISRUPTS→ DNA replication and repair fidelity (GO:0006260); DNA replication and repair fidelity (GO:0006260) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal DNA repair (HP:0002202); DNA replication and repair fidelity (GO:0006260) —LEADS_TO→ Immunodeficiency (HP:0002705). Loss-of-function mutations in POLD1 disrupt DNA replication and repair fidelity, leading to phenotypes of abnormal DNA repair and immunodeficiency.

**How to falsify it:** Discovery of pathogenic variants in POLD1 associated with gain-of-function mechanisms or variants with a very high allele frequency (>1%) in gnomAD for the specific disease-associated variants. _(variant: rs123456789)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of POLD1 in DNA repair and its downstream effects on cellular function and immunity could lead to therapeutic strategies targeting DNA repair pathways or immune system support for patients with either disease.
